$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot b\cdot c\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡A \\ \frac{85\sqrt{2}}{36} & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot b\cdot \frac{17}{3}\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{45}^{∘} \\ \frac{85\sqrt{2}}{36} & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot b\cdot \frac{17}{3}\cdot \left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) \\ \frac{85\sqrt{2}}{36} & =\frac{17\sqrt{2}}{12}b \\ b & =\frac{\frac{85\sqrt{2}}{36}}{\frac{17\sqrt{2}}{12}} \\ b & =\frac{5}{3}\text{ mm}.\end{aligned}
